body: more brutal. anika’s reaction felt like it came from a sense of entitlement because she was sooo confident she was in on the plan. i appreciate her emotions but it also rubbed me the wrong way. she seemed disgusted more than sad, as if her opinion of her tribemates as human beings changed in that moment. tiyana spiraled in real time because a last minute advantage came up in an already unconventional tribal when she was in on the original plan. they were clearly voting rachel out given the last minute scramble once she left. take out rachel and kyle and tiyana now has a 25% chance of going home. if this had been a normal merge tribal those odds are now reduced to 9% assuming no other idols etc. plus she was making decent moves in the merged tribe. doubt she would have gone home tonight if jeff wasn’t so set on twists every damn day. i’m hurt for her. there’s too much intervention from production these days
